description: This file defines the OpportunitiesQuickCreate class responsible for handling the quick creation form of Opportunities within SuiteCRM. It extends the QuickCreate class and manages form processing, including setting up JavaScript, assigning language-specific options, and preparing the form for AJAX or standard submission.

classes.name: OpportunitiesQuickCreate
classes.description: A class extending QuickCreate to enable quick creation of Opportunities with pre-processing and JavaScript setup.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the display logic for the quick create form, setting up JavaScript, language strings, and form options.
